newsitem.title: FRANCE: French PM Juppe on TV Sunday 1700 GMT.
newsitem.headline: French PM Juppe on TV Sunday 1700 GMT.

text.p: French Prime Minister Alain Juppe will appear on French television on Sunday at 1700 GMT.
TF1 television said in a statement he would be the guest on its one-to-one interview programme which runs from 1700 GMT to 1800 GMT on Sunday, April 27.
France's political parties are on the campaign trail ahead of a two-round May 25/June 1 parliamentary election and Juppe unveiled his centre-right ruling coaliton's platform on Tuesday.
